label: Blue Zone
strategy1: Try a slow stretch, or a glass of water — sometimes the body needs a small nudge before the mind follows.
strategy2: A few deep breaths can help lift your energy a little, even just a notch.
strategy3: Just naming it — ’I think I’m in the blue zone’ — out loud or in your head, can help.

label: Green Zone
strategy1: You’re in a good spot — this is a great time to start something you’ve been putting off.
strategy2: Notice what’s helping you feel this way, so you can find it again later.
strategy3: No need to fix anything right now — just enjoy it.

label: Yellow Zone
strategy1: A few slow breaths can help bring the energy down a notch, whichever direction it’s heading.
strategy2: Naming exactly what you’re feeling can help it feel less big than it seems.
strategy3: Moving your body — a walk, a stretch, shaking it out — can help release some of that energy.

label: Red Zone
strategy1: This is a big one — find a safe, quiet space if you can, even just for a minute.
strategy2: Slow counting, or squeezing something tight, can help the body calm down before anything else.
strategy3: You don’t have to solve anything right now — just focus on getting a little calmer first.
